canonical_project: Ladakh State Data Centre, Upper Tukcha, Leh
owner: Information Technology Department, Administration of Union Territory of Ladakh / NIC support
notes: UT Ladakh official release documented January 2024 review of ongoing work on the Ladakh State Data Centre at the Civil Secretariat in Leh; local press reports the state-of-the-art facility was inaugurated at Upper Tukcha, Leh on October 4, 2024. No public MW capacity found.
